plain: An official who looks over people or things to see that rules are kept

webster.text: One who inspects, views or oversees; as an inspector of morals; an inspector of the press.

example.quote: That every elector, before he is admitted to vote, shall, if required by the returning-officer or either of the inspectors, take an oath, or, if of the people called Quakers, an affirmation, of allegiance to the State.
